verdict.rationale: Riveter is documented only as a hosted API with SDKs and remote or local MCP connectors. Nothing in the evidence describes a Docker image or a self-hosted, containerized deployment of the scraping service. The local MCP option that runs on Node.js is a client connector, not a deployable scraping service, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the scraping service via a Docker container for production use
